author: dosumis
body:
mGluR1α is localized to dendrioles - see https://www.jneurosci.org/content/26/36/9184 figure 2
direct assay evidence

Calretenin is localized to dendrioles (brushes) in UBCs see https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/neuroscience/articles/10.3389/fnins.2020.598548/full#F3

protein: calretenin  - possibly Q08331 CALB2
PMID: 33488348
GO term: GO:0044293 dendriole
evidence: IDA
species: Mus musculus

protein: mGluR1α (not sure which UniProt ID to use)
species: Mus musculus
GO term: GO:0044293 dendriole
PMID: 16957075
evidence: IDA



CC @pgaudet
title: Dendriole annotations
